title: Awareness of social norms and accessibility
slide_intent: Represent people as active individuals and align image with text because recognition and understanding depend on more than visual appeal.
strategic_value: Helsinki can make its communications more inclusive by avoiding stereotypes and accounting for different levels of visual literacy.
demonstration: This webpage introduction pairs nonstereotyped representation with accessibility, meaningful image/text agreement and a supporting resource link.
practical_value: Check whose agency an image shows and whether it reinforces the accompanying message.

content_islands.name: Understanding
content_islands.spec: Follow with visual-literacy, image/text agreement and accessibility guidance and its link.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text links imagery to interest, understanding and memory.
reference_purposes.Application: It asks for people shown as themselves rather than demographic representatives and for aligned image/text meanings.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source states that communications must be widely understandable and accessible.
